corrections.corrected_statement: A diverging diamond interchange removes the troublesome left-turn movements of a standard interchange, which leaves fewer conflict points with other vehicles.
Snow and ice are at their most dangerous as they begin to melt, and slippery roads reduce tire grip and lengthen stopping distance.
To avoid the common left-turn crash with an oncoming cyclist, look for riders on the shoulder, at the lane edge or behind other vehicles and judge their speed and distance before turning.

Bicyclists are required to use hand signals when turning and stopping but may be unable to signal if their skill level or road or traffic conditions require both hands on the handlebars, so look for turning the head or looking over the shoulder as clues of intent.
corrections.note: Added missing traffic conditions as a reason for being unable to signal.

corrections.corrected_statement: Under the Move It Law a driver in a minor crash on a divided highway must move a drivable vehicle off the highway when no drugs or alcohol are involved and there are no injuries, and under Accident Alert Status when alcohol and drugs are not involved and there are no injuries and all vehicles are still drivable drivers must exchange information and file a report within twenty four hours.
corrections.note: Added missing no drugs or alcohol and no injuries and drivable conditions for both laws.

corrections.corrected_statement: When you encounter any stationary vehicle on a highway with its hazards flashing you must move over one lane if you can do so safely, and if it is not safe or you are on a road that is one lane in each direction you must slow down to at least twenty miles per hour below the posted speed limit.
corrections.note: Added missing stationary vehicle with hazards and one lane in each direction conditions.

corrections.corrected_statement: When turning right, start from the right-most part of your lane; when turning left, start from the left-most part of your lane.
corrections.note: The left turn portion completes on page five, not page four.

corrections.corrected_statement: If you fail the drive test you must wait until the next business day before retaking the test.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported claim about the written test.

corrections.corrected_statement: When turning right always turn from the right most portion of your lane and when turning left always turn from the left most portion of your lane.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported test taker behavior claim and completed rule on page five.
